summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Alterity Therapeutics Ltd, an Australian foreign private issuer, for July 2026. The filing incorporates an exhibit (99.1) which is an application for quotation of securities – ATH, relating to a routine listing of shares on an Australian exchange. No transaction, strategic shift, or special situation event is disclosed. This is a standard periodic report of a foreign issuer, not a special situation. Accordingly, no deal terms, strategic review, or activist campaign is indicated. The filing is purely administrative and regulatory in nature.
